the-fool.name: The Fool
the-fool.kw: adventure • risk • innocence • spontaneity • new beginning
the-fool.upright: Archetype of the Divine Innocent embarking on the cosmic journey. Upright, The Fool represents pure potential, unconditioned faith, infinite possibilities, spontaneous adventure, and taking a leap of divine faith into the unknown without fear.
the-fool.reversed: Recklessness, unconsidered risks, naivety, foolish impulsiveness, stalling due to fear of the unknown, or ignoring wise counsel while acting carelessly.
the-fool.guidance: Trust the unseen currents of the universe. Step forward with open-hearted wonder, but remain mindful of where your feet fall on the precipice of new beginnings.

the-magician.name: The Magician
the-magician.kw: manifestation • resourcefulness • power • inspired action • willpower
the-magician.upright: Master of the four elemental realms (Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles). Upright, The Magician represents conscious manifestation, divine willpower, resourcefulness, focused intention, mastery of energy, and bridging the spiritual down into the material.
the-magician.reversed: Illusion, manipulation, unused talents, wasted potential, trickery, misdirected willpower, or difficulty concentrating internal power into tangible reality.
the-magician.guidance: Align your high intent with disciplined action. All the elemental tools and infinite power to craft your reality are already in your hands.

the-priestess.name: The High Priestess
the-priestess.kw: intuition • wisdom • secrets • divine feminine • subconscious
the-priestess.upright: Guardian of the sacred veil, seated between light and dark pillars (Jachin and Boaz). Upright, The High Priestess symbolizes divine feminine intuition, esoteric wisdom, hidden mysteries, subconscious depth, dreams, and sacred silence.
the-priestess.reversed: Repressed intuition, secret agendas, surface superficiality, ignored inner wisdom, emotional detachment, or fear of diving into the subconscious.
the-priestess.guidance: Withdraw into the quiet sanctuary of your inner soul. The answers you seek cannot be found in external noise, but in the silent whispers of intuition.

the-empress.name: The Empress
the-empress.kw: fertility • femininity • beauty • abundance • nature • nurturing
the-empress.upright: Mother Archetype and embodiment of Venus. Upright, The Empress signifies lush abundance, creative fertility, sensual beauty, unconditional nurturing, nature's harmony, and the culmination of heartfelt creation.
the-empress.reversed: Creative blockage, smothering attachment, codependency, neglect of self-care, feelings of scarcity, or disharmony with natural cycles.
the-empress.guidance: Immerse yourself in nature and self-compassion. Allow your creative seeds to germinate at their natural pace, knowing you are inherently worthy of abundance.

the-emperor.name: The Emperor
the-emperor.kw: authority • leadership • power • control • stability • father figure
the-emperor.upright: Embodiment of Archetypal Divine Masculine and divine order. Upright, The Emperor represents structural authority, wise leadership, firm discipline, strategic organization, stability, and protective strength.
the-emperor.reversed: Rigidity, tyrannical control, abuse of power, lack of discipline, structural weakness, chaos, or stubborn inflexibility.
the-emperor.guidance: Establish order, clear boundaries, and grounded authority in your life. Lead with integrity, courage, and a structured vision for the future.

the-hierophant.name: The Hierophant
the-hierophant.kw: tradition • wisdom • religion • conformity • morality • ethics
the-hierophant.upright: Keeper of sacred tradition and spiritual doctrine. Upright, The Hierophant represents spiritual mentorship, sacred lineage, traditional wisdom, moral integrity, shared beliefs, and institutional learning.
the-hierophant.reversed: Dogmatism, blind conformity, spiritual rebellion, rigid orthodoxies, outdated beliefs, or finding your own unorthodox path beyond dogmatic rules.
the-hierophant.guidance: Honor the timeless wisdom of mentors and tradition, but ensure your personal code of ethics aligns genuinely with your soul's authentic path.

the-lovers.name: The Lovers
the-lovers.kw: love • harmony • relationships • choices • alignment • union
the-lovers.upright: Sacred union under Archangel Raphael's blessing. Upright, The Lovers symbolizes divine alignment, soul relationships, emotional and spiritual harmony, personal values alignment, and choosing path of truth over compromise.
the-lovers.reversed: Internal disharmony, misaligned values, relationship conflict, indecision, temptation, or compromising core values to appease another.
the-lovers.guidance: Seek union through radical honesty and self-alignment. Make choices that reflect your highest values and nurture authentic soul connections.

the-chariot.name: The Chariot
the-chariot.kw: control • willpower • success • action • determination • victory
the-chariot.upright: Triumphant conqueror controlling opposing black and white sphinxes through sheer willpower. Upright, The Chariot signifies decisive victory, laser focus, self-mastery, driven determination, and overcoming dualistic conflict.
the-chariot.reversed: Loss of control, directionlessness, uncontrolled aggression, succumbing to external chaos, or being derailed by opposing inner forces.
the-chariot.guidance: Harness your opposing impulses with focused resolve. Discipline your emotional mind and steer your path forward with unwavering determination.

strength.name: Strength
strength.kw: courage • patience • compassion • influence • inner strength
strength.upright: Maiden taming the roaring lion with gentle compassion and the infinity symbol above her head. Upright, Strength signifies spiritual fortitude, gentle mastery, patience, unconditional love, inner courage, and calming raw emotion.
strength.reversed: Self-doubt, raw emotional outbursts, weakness, insecurity, feeling overwhelmed by base desires, or relying on force rather than compassion.
strength.guidance: Conquer challenges not through brute force, but through patient, gentle self-mastery and quiet inner conviction.

the-hermit.name: The Hermit
the-hermit.kw: solitude • introspection • searching • guidance • inner wisdom
the-hermit.upright: Wise elder holding the glowing lantern of truth atop the solitary mountain peak. Upright, The Hermit represents deep soul-searching, spiritual retreat, inner illumination, introspection, quiet wisdom, and seeking truth away from worldly distractions.
the-hermit.reversed: Loneliness, social isolation, paranoia, stubborn withdrawal from life, or refusing to listen to inner wisdom.
the-hermit.guidance: Step away from outer noise to shine the lantern of introspection inward. The path forward becomes crystal clear in quiet solitude.

wheel-of-fortune.name: Wheel of Fortune
wheel-of-fortune.kw: karma • destiny • cycles • change • good luck • turning point
wheel-of-fortune.upright: The sacred cosmic wheel turning through sphinxes, alchemical symbols, and destiny. Upright, Wheel of Fortune symbolizes karmic turns, cosmic cycles, inevitable change, divine timing, good luck, and life breakthroughs.
wheel-of-fortune.reversed: Resistance to inevitable change, bad luck, feeling trapped in negative cycles, or clinging to the past during a cosmic shift.
wheel-of-fortune.guidance: Remain centered at the hub of the wheel while outer circumstances turn. Trust divine timing and adapt gracefully to life's shifting tides.

justice.name: Justice
justice.upright: Goddess of Truth holding the sword of clarity and golden scales of balance. Upright, Justice signifies karmic law, absolute fairness, truth, objective truthfulness, legal resolution, and cause-and-effect accountability.
justice.reversed: Unfairness, dishonesty, avoiding accountability, legal complications, bias, or refusing to accept responsibility for past actions.
justice.guidance: Act with absolute honesty, transparency, and fairness. Weigh your actions carefully, for the universe always seeks cosmic equilibrium.

the-hanged-man.name: The Hanged Man
the-hanged-man.kw: surrender • pause • perspective • letting go • enlightenment
the-hanged-man.upright: Martyr hanging upside-down surrounded by a golden halo of enlightenment. Upright, The Hanged Man represents surrender, peaceful pause, gaining a radically new perspective, letting go of control, and spiritual illumination.
the-hanged-man.reversed: Stalling, stubborn resistance, useless martyrdom, feeling suspended against your will, or delaying necessary sacrifices.
the-hanged-man.guidance: Release the desperate need to force outcomes. Suspend judgment and allow a peaceful surrender to open your eyes to divine perspective.

death.name: Death
death.kw: transformation • rebirth • endings • transition • new beginning
death.upright: Armored knight of transformation sweeping away the old to yield the golden sun of rebirth. Upright, Death represents profound transformation, fundamental endings, shedding worn-out skins, rebirth, and clearing space for new life.
death.reversed: Fear of change, resisting the natural end of a cycle, holding onto toxic patterns, stagnation, or painful delayed transitions.
death.guidance: Welcome necessary endings without fear. What dies today clears sacred fertile ground for your most luminous rebirth tomorrow.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.upright: Winged Angel pouring divine nectar between two golden cups. Upright, Temperance symbolizes alchemical balance, moderation, patience, spiritual integration, harmonious synthesis, and calm emotional regulation.
temperance.reversed: Excess, imbalance, extreme behavior, lack of patience, emotional volatility, or disharmony among opposing elements.
temperance.guidance: Blend life's diverse experiences with patience and moderation. Middle-ground alchemy brings lasting peace and energetic equilibrium.

the-devil.name: The Devil
the-devil.kw: attachment • restriction • illusion • temptation • shadow self
the-devil.upright: Figures bound by loose chains to the altar of illusion and earthly shadow. Upright, The Devil represents shadow projection, unhealthy addictions, material attachment, limiting beliefs, self-imposed bondage, and primal obsession.
the-devil.reversed: Breaking free from chains, overcoming addiction, releasing limiting beliefs, shadow integration, and reclaiming personal freedom.
the-devil.guidance: Examine the chains you hold in your hands. Realize that material illusions only possess the power you yield to them; reclaim your freedom.

the-tower.name: The Tower
the-tower.kw: upheaval • sudden change • awakening • revelation • breakthrough
the-tower.upright: Lightning striking the rigid stone tower, shattering false illusions. Upright, The Tower signifies sudden awakening, breakdown of false structures, liberation, sudden breakthrough, unexpected revelation, and clearing room for truth.
the-tower.reversed: Averting necessary disaster, delaying inevitable breakdown, fear of suffering, or holding onto crumbling foundations.
the-tower.guidance: Do not mourn the collapse of false illusions. When rigid structures break down, divine truth shines cleanly through the rubble.

the-star.name: The Star
the-star.kw: hope • faith • inspiration • renewal • serenity • blessings
the-star.upright: Water-bearer pouring sacred water under eight shining cosmic stars. Upright, The Star symbolizes luminous hope, faith, divine inspiration, emotional renewal, tranquility, spiritual clarity, and cosmic blessings.
the-star.reversed: Lack of faith, despair, cynicism, self-doubt, discouragement, or feeling disconnected from divine grace.
the-star.guidance: Keep your gaze fixed on hope and higher inspiration. Peace and cosmic renewal follow the storm; trust your guiding star.

the-moon.name: The Moon
the-moon.upright: Twin towers flanking the creature emerging from subconscious waters beneath the lunar glow. Upright, The Moon represents deep intuition, subconscious dreams, navigating shadow illusions, psychological depth, mystery, and psychic sensitivity.
the-moon.reversed: Unveiling deception, confusion clearing, overcoming irrational fears, repressed anxieties surfacing, or clarity replacing illusion.
the-moon.guidance: Trust your intuitive internal compass when navigating murky waters. Shadows and fears are merely illusions dissolving under morning light.

the-sun.name: The Sun
the-sun.kw: joy • success • vitality • warmth • clarity • abundance
the-sun.upright: Child riding white horse under radiant solar rays and sunflowers. Upright, The Sun symbolizes unclouded joy, radiant vitality, success, warm enthusiasm, absolute clarity, childlike wonder, and abundant fulfillment.
the-sun.reversed: Temporary sadness, clouded joy, delayed success, unrealistic optimism, or needing to reconnect with inner warmth.
the-sun.guidance: Step into the light of unclouded truth and joy. Radiate your authentic warmth and celebrate the divine brilliance within you.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.upright: Archangel Gabriel sounding the trumpet of resurrection over rising souls. Upright, Judgement signifies spiritual awakening, divine calling, soul evaluation, absolution, major life decisions, and stepping into a higher octave of existence.
judgement.reversed: Self-doubt, harsh self-criticism, ignoring your soul's calling, indecision, or dwelling on past regrets and mistakes.
judgement.guidance: Answer the horn call of your higher self. Forgive the past, release self-criticism, and step fearlessly into your soul's rebirth.

the-world.name: The World
the-world.upright: Sacred dancer encircled by the cosmic laurel wreath and four evangelist figures. Upright, The World represents ultimate completion, holistic integration, global consciousness, fulfillment, victory, and mastering a major life cycle.
the-world.reversed: Seeking closure, unfinished business, short-cuts, delays in final completion, or feeling stuck on the final step.
the-world.guidance: Celebrate how far you have journeyed. You stand whole and complete, ready to step onto a higher spiral of cosmic evolution.

howToRead.appStep1Title: Step 1: Calm Your Mind & Set Clear Intention
howToRead.appStep1Desc: Before drawing cards, take a deep breath and clear your mind of daily distractions. Focus clearly on the area seeking guidance (love, career, personal growth). Type your query into the app's intention box to align your energy with the cards.
howToRead.appStep1Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Ask open-ended, empowering questions like 'What direction should I take?' rather than simple yes/no questions.
howToRead.appStep2Title: Step 2: Select the Right Sacred Spread
howToRead.appStep2Desc: Choose the reading layout that matches your depth of inquiry. Use 'Single Card' or '3-Card (Past, Present, Future)' for quick daily insights, 'Celtic Cross (10 Cards)' for complex life situations, or 'Love Spread' for relationship dynamics.
howToRead.appStep2Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: For beginners, the 3-Card spread is ideal for observing time progression and underlying cause-and-effect patterns.
howToRead.appStep3Title: Step 3: Draw Cards & Observe Sacred Imagery
howToRead.appStep3Desc: Tap 'Shuffle & Draw' to activate the digital card shuffle. When cards reveal, pay attention to your immediate intuitive impression and visual response to the classic Rider-Waite archetypes and color symbolism.
howToRead.appStep3Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Your immediate gut feeling in the first few seconds often carries the purest intuitive message before intellect intervenes.
howToRead.appStep4Title: Step 4: Synthesize Insights & Save to Journal
howToRead.appStep4Desc: Review upright and reversed meanings, elemental harmonies (Fire, Water, Air, Earth), and detailed position analysis. Record your takeaways in the 'Reflection Journal' to track your personal growth and spiritual syncs over time.
howToRead.appStep4Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Consistent reflection journaling sharpens your intuitive faculties and reveals subtle synchronicities in your daily path.
howToRead.physStep1Title: Step 1: Cleanse Your Deck & Personal Space
howToRead.physStep1Desc: Before handling your physical Rider-Waite deck, cleanse accumulated ambient energies. Pass the cards through sage incense, place them atop a selenite crystal, or gently knock three times on the deck to reset its energetic vibration.
howToRead.physStep1Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Create a calm ritual workspace with a clean altar cloth, candle flame, or grounding crystals to sharpen focus.
howToRead.physStep2Desc: Hold the deck in both hands to infuse your personal aura. Shuffle slowly while concentrating deeply on your intention. When your intuition feels complete, split the deck into three piles using your left hand, then recombine.
howToRead.physStep2Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: If a card flies out while shuffling (a 'jumper card'), pay close attention—it often carries a direct, urgent insight.
howToRead.physStep3Title: Step 3: Lay Out Cards in Sacred Order
howToRead.physStep3Desc: Place cards face-down according to your chosen layout (e.g., 3-Card trajectory or Celtic Cross). Flip them sequentially. Pay careful attention to card orientation (upright/reversed), directional gazes of characters, and visual patterns.
howToRead.physStep3Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Figures facing each other suggest dialogue and harmony; figures looking away signal hidden tension or dynamic contrast.
howToRead.physStep4Title: Step 4: Interpret Wisdom & Cross-Reference with TarotEdu
howToRead.physStep4Desc: Look up your drawn physical cards inside TarotEdu's Academy tab. Combine your personal intuitive readings with the app's rich database of authentic Rider-Waite symbolism, astrological rulers, and elemental correspondences.
howToRead.physStep4Tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Log your physical readings into TarotEdu's reflection journal to build a searchable, lifelong tarot archive.
